note: A turn uses one work-time header above its process content. Before process content arrives a synthetic row shows the same label. Saved and streamed projections of the same turn share that header position; any process disclosure replaces their placeholders. The disclosure is available while running and defaults open; terminal completion defaults it closed unless the user chose otherwise or a child still needs attention. Final assistant text stays outside the process and freezes its elapsed time without ending the turn.
changeNote: 2026-11-03: Only a leading live user opens a turn segment. Follow-ups after continuation work retain their arrival position even when steering metadata is absent; preserve real opener and work-header ownership.

rules.elapsedBase: max((finalAssistantStartedAtMs ?? completedAtMs ?? now) - startedAtMs, 0), whole seconds
rules.rowShape: label row followed by a full-width hairline rule
rules.livePlacement: above the first work item, after leading user, external and worktree rows
rules.liveOpener: only a user leading the live segment; follow-ups after existing work retain their arrival position even without steering metadata
rules.completionTransition: the same disclosure header remains in place while its process content collapses
rules.runningStateOwner: activeTurnId, including an empty continuation before its first content
